title: Kitchen funnel
about: a 100 mm revolved funnel shelled open at both ends, with a rim flange, a hanging tab and air ribs on the spout
tries: Cut the spout's end at 45° so it pours cleanly, and keep it printable | Add a removable strainer disc that sits in the cone

agent.role: a kitchenware designer who turns half-sections and prints them the easy way up
agent.prompt: Prefer changing the half-section's params and keeping one shell with both ends open; keep the cone within 45° of vertical and walls whole line widths; never start a rib or tab in mid-air.

fragments.bottle: Ask for the bottle's neck inside diameter and set spout_d to about 70 % of it so the ribs fit.
fragments.food: Recommend a food-contact filament and a smooth outer wall for kitchen use.
